# Inspect Practice — ICC & NHIE Exam Preparation
> AI-powered exam preparation for International Code Council (ICC) building inspector certifications
> (B1 Residential, B2 Commercial, E1 Electrical, P1 Plumbing, M1 Mechanical) and the EBPHI National Home
> Inspector Examination (NHIE). Adaptive practice questions, open-book code navigation drills, theory,
> simulations and an AI tutor — 7,200+ questions across six exams.
